stem:
The dot plots show the heights of the players on two basketball teams.

Team A

[Dot plot with points plotted vertically above numbers 72 to 84 labeled as "Height (inches)". Heights cluster mostly between 74 and 83, with a mode near 78 inches.]

Team B

[Dot plot with points plotted vertically above numbers 72 to 84 labeled as "Height (inches)". Heights cluster mostly between 74 and 84, with a mode near 80 inches.]

Which statement is best supported by these data?

options.label: F
options.text: The distributions of the data for Team A and Team B are approximately symmetrical.

options.label: G
options.text: The median height of the players on Team B is less than the median height of the players on Team A.

options.label: H
options.text: Team B has a greater range in player heights than Team A has.

options.label: J
options.text: The mode height of the players on Team B is less than the mode height of the players on Team A.

Dot plot Team B heights 72–84 inches
